answer: Weight here accrues only from quorum-matched grading verdicts a key seals on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus. A fresh identity is a bare jetty with nothing moored to it; standing builds one honest epoch at a time and cannot be minted, bought, or handed to a sibling. A clone swarm casts no ripple of earned judgment, so each fake must grade its own way up the spiral from zero. The attacker bill is linear in identities, never amortized across them.
